name: Village Plaza at Bunker Hill
summary: Village Plaza at Bunker Hill is a 491,640 square foot community center prominently located on Katy Freeway in West Houston's affluent Memorial area. The center features strong anchor tenants and diverse dining options serving a trade area with average household incomes exceeding $174,000 and a robust daytime population of over 161,000 professionals.
demographics: Village Plaza at Bunker Hill serves an affluent West Houston market with a 3-mile trade area averaging $174,183 in household income and median household income of $96,444. The center attracts a strong daytime population of over 161,000 professionals within 3 miles, significantly exceeding the residential population of 139,905, indicating robust office worker traffic. The trade area features predominantly high-income households with concentrations in the $150K-$300K+ income brackets, and a per capita income of $66,584, reflecting an educated, professional demographic with significant purchasing power.
description: Village Plaza at Bunker Hill is a prominent community shopping center strategically positioned at 9710 Katy Freeway in Houston's thriving West Houston corridor. Located in a strong, revitalizing regional retail node, the center benefits from exceptional visibility along one of Houston's major thoroughfares and serves as a retail hub for the affluent Memorial and Energy Corridor communities. The 491,640 square foot center features a powerful lineup of anchor tenants complemented by a diverse array of specialty shops and restaurants that serve as magnets for the area's substantial daytime population of over 161,000 professionals. The property's strategic location capitalizes on the concentration of corporate offices and high-income residential neighborhoods in the Bunker Hill area, creating consistent traffic throughout the day. With strong demographics including a 3-mile average household income exceeding $174,000 and excellent access from the Katy Freeway, Village Plaza at Bunker Hill has established itself as a premier shopping and dining destination in West Houston's competitive retail landscape.
